steps.procedure_step: Divide the composite shape into simple sub-shapes (rectangles, circles, triangles).
steps.work: Divide the L-shape into the non-overlapping bottom and upper-left rectangles.

steps.procedure_step: Identify the reference axis (usually the bottom-left corner or a specified origin).
steps.work: Use the outside lower-left corner as the origin.

steps.procedure_step: Calculate the area Aᵢ of each sub-shape.
Locate the centroid (xᵢ, yᵢ) of each sub-shape from the reference axis.
Compute the moment for each sub-shape: Aᵢxᵢ and Aᵢyᵢ.
Sum all moments: ΣAᵢxᵢ and ΣAᵢyᵢ.
Divide: x̄ = ΣAᵢxᵢ / ΣAᵢ and ȳ = ΣAᵢyᵢ / ΣAᵢ.
